Talk in English, Urdu or both. Tap the floating mic in any app, and Murmur types what you said into the box you\'re in. It\'s free with a Gemini key.
Switch to it when you want to talk: tap the keyboard button at the bottom of your screen, or the globe key.

Tap here, switch to Murmur, and talk

Your keys and settings stay on this phone. Your audio goes only to the service you picked (Gemini by default). On Gemini\'s free tier, Google may use what you send to improve its products. Nothing else is sent anywhere.

Shows a small mic button while you type in any app. Tap it and talk, and Murmur types what you said into that text box. Murmur only reads which text box is focused, so it knows where to show the bubble and put your words. Your audio goes only to the speech service you chose in Murmur.
In Accessibility, open Murmur mic bubble and turn it on. If Android says it\'s a restricted setting, tap App info, then ⋮ (top right), then Allow restricted settings, and try again.
If you\'d rather not use the bubble, switch to the Murmur keyboard when you want to talk.
